results.title: [API] Bot message rate limit · Issue #20 · discord/discord-api-docs
results.snippet: A global 50/10 rate limit (meaning, this is the maximum # of messages a bot can send currently across all of discord). A 5/5 per server rate limit. A 5/5 global DM rate limit. The rate limit applies to message creation and editing.

results.title: Ratelimits | Javacord
results.snippet: You can clearly see the delay between every 5 sent messages. No. Ratelimits are a limitation from Discord itself, which you cannot circumvent.
